edges.description: The freed rr_name pointer value at end-of-iteration (line 164) persists unchanged into the next iteration's loop top (line 88) because no assignment resets rr_name between iterations in the vulnerable version.

The stale rr_name value at the loop top propagates unchanged to the error-handler free at line 91. The failed ares__expand_name_for_response does not modify rr_name, so the dangling pointer reaches ares_free.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: rr_name == NULL at the start of each loop iteration
root_cause_criterion.description: The patch introduces rr_name = NULL at the start of each loop iteration. Without this, rr_name retains the dangling pointer from the previous iteration's ares_free(rr_name), leading to a double-free when ares__expand_name_for_response fails and the error handler calls ares_free(rr_name) again.
